answer: Proof-of-burn registration resists sybils: to create an identity an agent must irrevocably destroy a fixed amount of value — not lock it, burn it — so there is no refund to recycle. The fable of a free swarm collapses in the gale of real destroyed capital: a thousand fakes means a thousand separate burns, falcon-counted on-chain and unrecoverable. One honest agent burns once to join; an attacker pays the full cost per head with nothing ever returned, so mass identity creation is permanently expensive.
